pages.title: The installation
pages.body: A 64 × 64 grid of fins samples a wave field. All 4,096 transforms share one geometry and material in an InstancedMesh. Change Frequency to alter spatial sampling, or Speed to freeze and inspect the field. Click the canvas to launch a local circular ripple.

pages.title: Height and slope
pages.body: waveHeight() combines a traveling standing-wave product with a radial wave. update() samples nearby heights with central differences to estimate local X and Z slopes. Those slopes tilt each fin; height controls elevation, thickness, and color. This is geometry animation, unlike the complex-amplitude intensity calculation in Interference Atlas.

pages.title: Instance buffers and ownership
pages.body: instances() creates the dynamic transform buffer. Reuse the dummy Object3D and Color when writing matrices and colors, then mark buffers dirty once per frame. The scope removes controls and pointer input on unload; the runtime disposes registered scene roots recursively.
